steps_h2: How to Make a Product Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Pick a guide, use your own product, and download the photo or video you need for your next post.

steps.d: Take a clear photo of the product you sell, then choose the guide for your next photo or ad.
Follow the guide to upload your photo or paste your product link. Review the result before you spend credits again.
Download your finished image or video and post it where its size fits.

faq.q: What can I learn from these product guides?
faq.a: Learn how to take a product photo, prepare a white main image, make a first video ad, choose ad sizes, and compare creative versions.

faq.q: How do I use a guide to make an ad?
faq.a: Open the guide for your task, follow its steps, then use the linked tool with your own product photo or product page.

faq.q: Can I make an ad without booking a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a clear photo you already have. The guides show how to turn that photo into a product image or ad.
Sellers making their own product photos and ads, and small teams that need clear steps for the next campaign.

faq.q: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.a: No. Each guide explains the steps and the file you will make. You can start with one clear product photo.

faq.q: Will these guides work for my kind of store?
faq.a: Yes. Use the photo, video, and ad guides that fit your product. Check the relevant industry guide for product-specific ideas.

faq.q: Can I reuse one product photo in several guides?
faq.a: Yes. Use a clear photo across different guides, then check each result before you post it. Each new image or video uses credits.

faq.q: Where can I post the result?
faq.a: Post it where the format fits: a product page, social feed, Story, or paid ad. Check the [platform pages](page:video-hub) for sizes.

faq.q: How many credits do photos and videos use?
faq.a: One image is 24 credits. Videos use 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 for 200 monthly credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use my download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use your watermark-free download in ads or on your store, and check each platform’s rules before posting.

faq.q: Which guide helps me make a video with a presenter?
faq.a: Start with the first video ad guide. You can choose a presenter for the video or keep the product in focus.
A guide gives you a clear starting point and a short set of checks before you make another version.
